dedupe_keys.name: fuel vehicle type and age specific co2 emissions from global on road vehicles

description: The global on-road vehicle emissions research team publishes carbon-dioxide emissions distinguished by fuel, vehicle type and vehicle age. Figshare version 6 provides two equivalent packaging routes: a NetCDF ZIP with a dimension-description spreadsheet and readme, and a MATLAB ZIP containing four data files with its own readme. The resource title establishes global coverage, but the brief repository description does not specify the reference years, grid spacing or units. Those details require consulting the supplied documentation before numerical reuse. Files are publicly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. This metadata limitation prevents immediate comparison of emission totals with a local fleet model. The categories could support transport decarbonisation simulations that vary vehicle technology and fleet age. The dataset complements road geometry and traffic observations with an emissions allocation by technology. No archive was opened and no inventory estimates were independently assessed.
